answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by linking equivocation evidence across bonded identities: when k coordinated keys sign conflicting histories, their correlated penalties scale as O(k²), draining escrow rather than treating each key as an isolated fault. A coordinator cannot make responsibility wander among aliases; detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes recovery of slashed collateral harder. Even a shale-thin stake spread across a jetty of identities therefore carries swarm-wide risk.
